guardrails: In-process ContentHost results are component/harness results only; they never satisfy formal ProcessContainer acceptance.

Direct synthetic Preedit/commit and software-injected text do not prove macOS system IME routing. A system-IME pass requires a native window receipt of the macOS input-method route, marked text, and commit; physical keyboard use is recorded separately.
Observed gates preserve this snapshot's strict #53 failure and DSH SideChat capability status by linking each outcome to evidence; newer evidence may update the outcome and matching cells.
